account.hostWhy: To list a garage we need to know who you are, so drivers can trust you. We ask once.

code.location_required: Mark your garage entrance on the map.
code.outside_radius: The garage must be within 3 km of the venue.
code.invalid_address: Enter the street, number and neighborhood.
code.invalid_municipality: Pick a municipality in the metropolitan area.
code.invalid_dimensions: Check the length, width and height.
code.vehicle_types_required: Pick at least one type of car that fits.
code.invalid_description: The description can have up to 500 characters.
code.too_many_photos: You can add up to 8 photos.
code.invalid_price: The price per hour must be between $20 and $500.
code.terms_required: To publish you must accept the host rules.
code.duplicate_space: You already listed a garage at this address.
code.not_editable: A garage under review or rejected can't be paused or resumed.
code.own_space: You can't book your own garage.

home.title: Host
home.introTitle: Rent out your garage on event days
home.introBody: List your garage or spot and earn by the hour when there's an event nearby. Before you list, we verify your identity, just like we do for drivers.
home.emptySpacesTitle: You haven't listed a garage yet
home.emptySpacesBody: List your first one: it takes a few minutes.
home.emptyBookingsBody: When a driver books one of your garages, it will show up here.

space.pendingNote: We're reviewing your photos and details. You'll see it here once it's live.
space.pausedNote: Paused: drivers can't see it. Bookings already confirmed still stand.

location.title: Where is your garage?
location.intro: Pick the nearest venue and mark the entrance. The exact address is only shown to whoever books.
location.referencesHint: Helps the driver find the entrance.
location.pinTitle: Mark the entrance on the map
location.pinHelp: Tap the map or use the arrows. The pin must be within {{radius}} of the venue.
location.noVenue: Pick the nearby venue first to see the map.
location.noPin: You haven't marked the entrance yet.
location.privacy: Only whoever books and confirms sees the exact address.

size.title: Space dimensions
size.intro: Measure where the car parks. We use it to suggest which cars fit.
size.typesHint: We suggest them from the measurements. You can change them.
size.noSuggestion: No standard car fits those measurements. Check the numbers.

photos.title: Photos and description
photos.intro: Show the entrance and where the car parks. We review them before publishing.
photos.badType: {{name}}: use JPG, PNG or WebP photos.
photos.uploadFailed: {{name}}: it couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
photos.descriptionHint: How to get in, hours, and what the driver should know.

price.title: Price
price.intro: Choose what you charge per hour. You can change it any time.
price.label: Price per hour (pesos)
price.feeNote: Drivers also pay a ParkApp service fee.
price.terms: I accept the host rules: keep the spot free during reserved hours and only receive people with a booking.

done.title: Your garage is under review
done.body: We review your photos and details before it goes live. It usually takes a short while, and you'll see the change in My garages.

mode.pitchBody: Earn by the hour when there is an event nearby.
mode.profileHostBody: List your garages and see the bookings you receive. It is the same account.
